hypothesis: Graphene, a 2D crystal of carbon, can be isolated through mechanical cleavage of graphite
prediction: Isolation of graphene sheets with a thickness of 1-10 layers
measurement_method: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) or Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM)
falsification_condition: If repeated attempts at mechanical cleavage of graphite fail to produce sheets with a thickness of less than 100 layers, or if the isolated sheets are found to be unstable and degrade rapidly in air.
